title: 基本操作｜queue：用 deque
question:
跟上一題一樣的三種指令，這次用 Python 的 deque（from collections import deque）：
1 x：x 排到最後面：q.append(x)
2：最前面的離開：q.popleft()；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
3：輸出最前面的數字 q[0]；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
deque 拿掉最前面的很快，不用像 list 那樣把後面的往前搬。
第一行輸入 N，接下來 N 行每行一個指令。每個要輸出的結果各輸出一行。

test_case.note: 先排的 10 先離開，所以第二次 front 是 20

en.title: Basics | queue: deque
en.question:
The same three commands as the last one. This time use the Python deque (from collections import deque):
1 x: x joins the back: q.append(x)
2: the front one leaves: q.popleft(). If it is empty, output Empty!
3: output the front number q[0]. If it is empty, output Empty!
A deque removes the front quickly. It does not move every item up like a list.
The first line is N. Then N lines, one command each. Output each result on its own line.

test_case.note: 10 came first and leaves first, so the second front is 20
